follow_marshal.text: Evacuate calmly under the drill marshal’s direction. Leave belongings behind.

keep_clear.text: Walk without pushing. Keep doorways clear.

avoid_smoke.text: Do not enter smoke or pass the simulated fire. Tell the drill marshal where you are.

blocked_report.text: Report the blocked route and your location to the drill marshal. Do not improvise a route.

stop_drill.text: If no approved clear route is available, stop this software drill and contact the instructor.

assistance_request.text: Tell the drill marshal your location and the assistance you need. Follow your agreed assistance arrangement.

no_rescue.text: Do not improvise a rescue or enter an unverified refuge. Ask the drill marshal for help.

assembly_check.text: At the designated assembly point, report to the attendance marshal and stay with your group.

no_reentry.text: Report missing people and their last known location. Do not re-enter to search.
